name: Ember Brand
description:
Weapon (Any Sword)
 A blade quenched in the Wyrmscar's own heat. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, and it sheds dim light out to 10 feet while anything undead stands within 60 feet of you.

name: The Reeve's Seal
description:
Wondrous Item
 A soot-blackened writ of authority from Emberwatch. Its bearer speaks for the holding, which is worth rather more on the road than it is at home.
